readout_other: redundancy/synergy (synergy minus redundancy rank gradient) analysis of resting fMRI
direction_notes: TUS shifted regions toward either redundancy or synergy depending on region and target; the effect is not classed as excitatory or inhibitory.

timing.protocol_description: 30-ms bursts of ultrasound every 100 ms for 40 s, both hemispheres at once with a single train, offline TUS then fMRI; at least 10 days between TUS sessions.
30-ms bursts of ultrasound every 100 ms for 40 s, both hemispheres at once with a single train, offline TUS then fMRI; at least 10 days between TUS sessions.

source_quotes.n_subjects: The data consists of three MRI sessions per control (non-TUS), SMA-TUS, and FPC-TUS, and macaque (N = 3).
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The protocol was controlled with a digital function generator (Handyscope HS5, TiePie engineering, Sneek, The Netherlands) setting to 250 kHz with 30-ms bursts of ultrasound generated every 100 ms.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: The protocol was controlled with a digital function generator (Handyscope HS5, TiePie engineering, Sneek, The Netherlands) setting to 250 kHz with 30-ms bursts of ultrasound generated every 100 ms.
